### The Piety of Ezra
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/piety-of-ezra
Passage: Ezra 7:27-28
Points:
- Ezra's prayer of praise reflects a deep conviction in God's supreme sovereignty over earthly authorities.
- Worldly rulers may appear to guide history, but God directs their hearts according to His providential plan.
- Any favor, goodwill, or help received from others originates ultimately from God's steadfast love and mercy.
- Recognizing that the gracious hand of God was upon him gave Ezra the courage to take action and lead.
- Believers should pray for God to grant favor in their endeavors and remember to thank Him when He provides it.
